x: The 1961 track season did not bring the overall success I had hoped for, writes Jack Hampshire Sen., but perhaps I expected too much, too soon after our successes of 1960.
Our newly formed boys' team (reports Jack Hampshire Sen.) did very well to make the first six in this year's championships at Morden Park on February 24th.
Another is J.Barnard who I know has been sought as a member by a number of prominent clubs. Jack Hampshire, Sen.
